high_level_description: The image shows two individuals wearing blue protective vests with the logo "THE HALO" on them. The vests appear to be part of safety gear used by deminers. Both individuals are dressed in black jackets, suggesting they might be working in a cold environment. The text overlay on the image provides information about the HALO Trust, which is described as the world's leading landmine clearance organization. It mentions that the HALO Trust has successfully neutralized over 19,000 landmines and unexploded ordnance in Ukraine.
